title: Chest X-rays and AI for tuberculosis screening
summary: Nexus AI says it has deployed Google Research's chest X-ray AI as a certified diagnostic tool at about 40 facilities in six countries: more than 25,000 X-rays assessed by over 90 clinicians, with response times under 45 seconds. These are author-reported deployment figures, with no sensitivity or patient outcome data; WHO and FDA approvals are still in progress.

evidence.tested: The post reports deployment figures (about 40 facilities, over 25,000 X-rays, over 90 clinicians) without sensitivity, specificity or patient outcome data from this deployment; it cites earlier peer-reviewed studies for performance.
evidence.unknown: Deployment-level accuracy and outcomes are not given, WHO prequalification and FDA clearance are not granted, and the facility count across countries is unclear.
evidence.ai_role: The AI analyzed chest X-rays and flagged TB-suggestive findings for triage in under 45 seconds; clinicians made final decisions.
